# Chartmux

> Chartmux turns CSV, JSON, and versioned chart specifications into terminal charts, PNG, SVG, and self-contained HTML.

## Primary pages

- [Product overview and playground](/): Interactive chart playground, chart contract, and supported chart catalog.

## Commands

- `chartmux demo --list`: List built-in chart demonstrations.
- `chartmux demo grouped-bar`: Display a grouped bar chart.
- `chartmux demo line --watch`: Open the responsive terminal UI.
- `chartmux sales.csv --type line --x month --series revenue,cost`: Build a chart from a dataset.

## Source

- [Chartmux on GitHub](https://github.com/mertdeveci5/chartmux)
